name: Good Samaritan
overview: The teaching of the Good Samaritan emphasizes the biblical command to love one's neighbor as oneself, rooted in God's law to love Him with all heart, soul, and might (Deuteronomy 6:5; Leviticus 19:18). Compassion and mercy toward others, especially those in need, reflect true obedience to God, as shown by the blessing on those who show mercy (Proverbs 14:21). The context of Jesus' ministry and His instruction to His disciples (Matthew 5:1; Luke 10:1) frame this teaching as essential for inheriting eternal life, responding to the question posed by a lawyer seeking to understand what is required (Luke 10:25).
